subject: Incremental audit payload handoff & attestation checklist
messages:
From: Anna Park <compliance@medicosys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Export window & attestations for admin activity (MedicoSys request)

Hi Soojin,

We're preparing for our annual SOC 2 re-audit (Jan window) and need a short checklist from Redwood describing the admin-activity export options you can provide. Specifically: incremental delivery cadence, manifest/attestation expectations, and a transport/fingerprint method for automated ingestion.

High level asks:
- Can you provide incremental exports (hourly/daily) in addition to on-demand full snapshots?
- What fields are included in the admin activity manifest? We need the manifest to include sequence ids, event types, actor id, timestamp (ISO8601 UTC), and an HMAC per-file.
- Do you sign manifests / provide a PKI thumbprint or HMAC secret we can verify?
- Retention/TTL options and recommended sample window for preserved logs for 90+ day audits.
- Any latency/slippage guarantees for near-real-time exports (SLOs)?

We'd like an example handoff plan and an attestation checklist we can attach to the auditor packet. Emma Liu from AuditWorks (cc) may follow up on technical attestation format.

Thanks,
Anna
Compliance Manager, MedicoSys
[attachment: medicosys_evidence_requirements_2026.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <compliance@medicosys.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Export window & attestations for admin activity (MedicoSys request)

Anna — thanks for the clear list. Drafting a concise playbook for you; see the outline and two handoff options below. Attached: admin_activity_manifest_schema_v2.json (manifest schema) and incremental-handoff-playbook-v2.pdf (playbook with timelines).

Summary (recommended):
- Mode A: Incremental (primary) + daily snapshot (secondary)
  - Incremental cadence: 1h chunks (configurable to 15m / 4h).
  - Files: gzip chunks with sequential name pattern: redwood-admin-YYYYMMDD-HH-N.gz
  - Manifest: JSON manifest per-batch containing file list, sequence_start, sequence_end, event_count, hmac_sha256 (hex), s3_path, utc_window_start, utc_window_end.
- Mode B: On-demand full snapshot (for one-off legal holds)
  - Delivery by signed manifest + signed tarball (SFTP or presigned S3).

Attestation options (choose one):
1) HMAC per-file with shared secret stored in your KMS; we publish manifest with hmac_sha256 and provide a rotating secret schedule (recommended for automation).
2) PKI-signed manifest (Redwood signs manifest with our code-signing cert; we provide certificate chain and thumbprint).
3) Dual: manifest PKI + per-file HMAC (highest assurance).

Retention & sampling:
- Default: 180 days retention for admin events in hosted accounts; can be extended to 3+ years on Dedicated/Private plans.
- We support snapshotting immutable bundles (WORM-style) for legal holds; recommended sample window for audit evidence: full contiguous 7–30 day window + representative hourly samples outside that window.

Operational notes / SLOs:
- Typical incremental availability: within 2x the configured chunk window (e.g., 1h chunks appear within ~90m).
- If you require sub-10m latency we can propose an eventstream connection (pub/sub) instead of bulk chunking (extra cost).

Next steps:
1) Confirm Mode (A or B) and cadence (15m/1h/4h).
2) Choose attestation method (HMAC | PKI | Dual).
3) We'll provision an SFTP fingerprint / presigned-bucket and share the initial manifest + secret rotation schedule.

I've included a short checklist at the top of the attached playbook. Vanessa, looping you for procurement/timelines. Karthik, please see the questions below about chunk-size and manifest fields — can you confirm the engineering constraints?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[attachment: admin_activity_manifest_schema_v2.json (application/json)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Anna Park <compliance@medicosys.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 14:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Export window & attestations for admin activity (MedicoSys request)

Soojin / Anna — technical confirmation and caveats below. Quoting Soojin's ask: "confirm engineering constraints".

Notes:
- Chunk sizing: 1h chunks are fine; we recommend targeting ~100–500MB compressed per chunk for stable S3 put performance. We'll cap file size at 1GB and roll a new chunk.
- Sequence ids: we'll include a monotonically increasing sequence number (global per-tenant) and sequence_start/sequence_end in manifest. This makes reassembly deterministic for ingesters.
- Timezones: we normalize timestamps to UTC in the event payload; manifest windows will be UTC. We'll also include original_local_tz if requested.
- Event completeness: admin events include: actor_id, actor_type (user/service), action (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/IMPERSONATE/GRANT), target_resource, resource_id, ip_address, user_agent, session_id (if applicable), kv_cache_ref (if relevant), and tokenized_request_id.
- Signed manifests: PKI signing is straightforward (we'll sign with our attest key and provide cert/sha256 thumbprint). HMAC option requires a secret exchange and rotation window — we can automate rotation via your KMS endpoint if you supply an AWS KMS ARN or similar.
- Transfer packaging: gz chunks + manifest.json. For high-assurance transfers we provide an attested SHA256 manifest + detached signature (.sig).

Caveats:
- Near-real-time streaming (sub-60s) is not supported by the default bulk export path; that would be an eventstream feature.
- Retention beyond tenant defaults requires a Dedicated/Private contract; we can scope a one-off archive for audits.

I'll attach a quick example manifest snippet in the playbook. If MedicoSys wants the HMAC route, PM / security will need to share a verification endpoint or KMS ARN.

- Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: incremental-handoff-playbook-v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Anna Park <compliance@medicosys.com>

Subject: Re: Export window & attestations for admin activity (MedicoSys request)

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Quick answers from our side:
- Mode: Mode A (Incremental 1h chunks) with daily snapshot retention for 90 days; we'll request an archival package (30d contiguous) if the auditor asks.
- Attestation: Let's go Dual (PKI-signed manifest + per-file HMAC). AuditWorks prefers both.
- Transfer: SFTP initially (we'll share a fingerprint); after that we can test presigned S3.

Action items:
- REDWOOD: please send the initial manifest & proof-of-export checklist to be attached to our SOC 2 packet. Include the cert thumbprint and a sample HMAC verification script.
- MEDICOSYS: we'll share SFTP details and the HubSpot agreement id (see link).
- AUDITWORKS (Emma): can you confirm the format you prefer for attestation in the auditor packet? We expect the signed manifest + sample events to be attached.

Emma: feel free to book 30m with Soojin / Karthik next week if you want to review the manifest and sample files.

Appreciate it — Anna
Compliance Manager, MedicoSys
